data.labels: Labels are used only after every evaluated mask has been fixed.
data.singleton_original_hyperedges: Excluded from incidence label-agreement means and reported separately.

label_agreement.definition: For original non-singleton incidence (v,e), h(v,e) is the fraction of other nodes u in e whose label equals y_v.
label_agreement.weighting: Each eligible original incidence has equal weight.
label_agreement.interpretation: Descriptive association only; higher homophily is not assumed to be universally beneficial.

fragmentation.singleton_budget_fraction: Fraction of retained original incidences whose retained hyperedge cardinality is exactly one.
fragmentation.ordinary_coverage: Fraction of originally connected nodes retaining at least one selected original incidence.
fragmentation.relational_coverage: Fraction of originally connected nodes retaining an incidence in a retained hyperedge of cardinality at least two.
